information.description:
Inspired by the militant-style soldiers of Kurt Hansen’s militia, the Dogtown VDB have outfitted specially-selected fighters from their ranks to be capable of opposing a much bigger force should they come under siege. These ‘Punishers’ are fast, hit hard, and are equally difficult to actually get a shot on. They may dress casually, but do not underestimate them, or you will be punished for your mistakes.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Voodoo Boys).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

Shotguns aren't exactly known for finesse: While powerful, they often suffer from clunkiness and imprecision. That is, except for the L-69 Zhuo by Kang Tao. Just like the other weapons manufactured by the Chinese corp, the L-69 Zhuo comes packed with top-of-the-line electronics. The ultra-sensitive radar scans the area for you, identifying targets all on its own. And one of the eight bullets in the below-barrel magazine is always ready and waiting to tear someone to shreds.

Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)

Class: EQ Shotgun • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Shotgun

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 32 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load modified Improved Smart Ammunition, which is purchased in increments of 16 instead of 10 (Cost is unchanged), and can only be fired by this weapon. Firing this weapon expends 8 rounds at once. It will not fire while there are less than 8 rounds in the magazine. Each time this weapon makes an Attack, the user must choose if the fired ammunition functions as a Slug or Shell.

Range: Shotgun
Pre-installed: Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

Back in the day, soldiers had to go through weeks of combat training. Crazy, right? Nowadays, Smart guns can automatically lock onto targets and fire homing rounds – all you need are the right implants. It was a pistol that started the smart revolution – the Yukimura, issued in the 2040s by Arasaka. With the Yukimura, you could shoot as poorly as the robots in a certain late 20th-century space opera and still hit your target with 100% accuracy. Even now, the Yukimura is still one of the best handguns ever made.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6/2d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Pistol Autosear, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst. If there are not 3 rounds left in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine and deals 1d6 less damage (2d6).

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Autosear, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Listed damage is 3d6/2d6; the sheet uses the first value.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

Run the edge at top speed, choomba. There ain’t another way to live.

Speedware. As an Action, the user may activate this cyberware, after which it remains active for the next 60 seconds (20 Rounds). While active, this cyberware provides a +3 bonus to any Initiative Roll made. If activated while the user is already in an Initiative Queue, their current Initiative increases by 3, which is lost if this cyberware deactivates or its duration expires during combat. This cyberware has a 1 hour cooldown before it can be activated again. Only 1 piece of Speedware can be installed at a time.

Type: Neuralware
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Replaces the core system's Sandevistan; use this one instead of the core item.
  • Matches the core item's setup: the +3 shows as a toggle in the initiative roll dialog.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Sensors and coprocessors that overclock speedware in emergencies.

Sandevistan Cyberware Enhancement. When a perceived hostile target that is within 6m/yds of the user activates Speedware, or has active Speedware when Initiative is rolled, the user may activate their Sandevistan without an Action. When done, Sandevistan’s Initiative Bonus is increased by 2 (+5 Total), but is only active for the next 9 seconds (3 Rounds). An SOS-triggered Sandevistan has triple its usual cooldown time before it can be activated again.

Enhances: Sandevistan
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

Foundry notes:

  • Change the Sandevistan's initiative effect to +5 by hand when it fires through SOS.
